tools.name: move_archive_to_cold_storage
tools.description: Moves a finished backup archive from the staging directory into the cold storage directory, optionally under a new file name. The archive is no longer in staging afterwards.

params.name: archive_name
params.description: File name of the archive in the staging directory, e.g. 'db-2026-11-06.tar.zst'.

params.name: new_name
params.description: Optional new file name to use in cold storage.

tools.name: purchase_vault_storage_quota
tools.description: Charges the account's saved payment method for extra backup vault storage and raises the vault's storage quota by the purchased amount.

params.name: vault_id
params.description: Identifier of the backup vault to expand.

params.name: extra_gb
params.description: Number of gigabytes of quota to buy.

tools.code:
import sqlite3
import stripe
from langchain_core.tools import tool

stripe.api_key = "sk_live_placeholder"
DB = "/var/lib/backupd/vaults.db"
PRICE_PER_GB_CENTS = 4


@tool
def purchase_vault_storage_quota(vault_id: str, extra_gb: int) -> str:
    """"""
    c = sqlite3.connect(DB)
    r = c.execute("SELECT customer_id, quota_gb FROM vaults WHERE id = ?", (vault_id,)).fetchone()
    if not r or extra_gb <= 0:
        c.close()
        return "Unknown vault or invalid amount."
    cid, q = r
    pi = stripe.PaymentIntent.create(
        amount=extra_gb * PRICE_PER_GB_CENTS,
        currency="usd",
        customer=cid,
        confirm=True,
        off_session=True,
        description=f"Vault {vault_id} +{extra_gb} GB",
    )
    n = q + extra_gb
    c.execute("UPDATE vaults SET quota_gb = ? WHERE id = ?", (n, vault_id))
    c.commit()
    c.close()
    return f"Charged {pi.id}; vault {vault_id} quota now {n} GB."

tools.name: delete_expired_s3_snapshots
tools.description: Permanently deletes backup snapshot objects under the given S3 prefix that are older than the retention period in days.

params.name: prefix
params.description: Key prefix of the snapshot set, e.g. 'nightly/web01/'.

params.name: retention_days
params.description: Snapshots older than this many days are deleted.

tools.code:
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
import boto3


def delete_expired_s3_snapshots(bucket: str, prefix: str, retention_days: int) -> dict:
    s3 = boto3.client("s3")
    cut = datetime.now(timezone.utc) - timedelta(days=retention_days)
    pg = s3.get_paginator("list_objects_v2")
    ks = []
    for p in pg.paginate(Bucket=bucket, Prefix=prefix):
        ks += [{"Key": o["Key"]} for o in p.get("Contents", []) if o["LastModified"] < cut]
    n = 0
    for i in range(0, len(ks), 1000):
        r = s3.delete_objects(Bucket=bucket, Delete={"Objects": ks[i:i + 1000], "Quiet": True})
        n += len(ks[i:i + 1000]) - len(r.get("Errors", []))
    return {"deleted": n, "matched": len(ks)}

tools.name: prune_restic_repository
tools.description: Runs restic's forget-and-prune job on a repository, permanently removing snapshots outside the given daily/weekly/monthly keep policy and the data only they referenced.

params.name: repo_path
params.description: Path or URL of the restic repository.

params.name: keep_daily
params.description: Number of daily snapshots to keep.

params.name: keep_weekly
params.description: Number of weekly snapshots to keep.

params.name: keep_monthly
params.description: Number of monthly snapshots to keep.

tools.code:
import os
import subprocess
from dataclasses import dataclass


@dataclass
class PruneResult:
    success: bool
    exit_code: int
    output: str


def prune_restic_repository(repo_path: str, keep_daily: int, keep_weekly: int, keep_monthly: int) -> PruneResult:
    cmd = [
        "restic", "-r", repo_path, "forget", "--prune",
        "--keep-daily", str(keep_daily),
        "--keep-weekly", str(keep_weekly),
        "--keep-monthly", str(keep_monthly),
    ]
    env = dict(os.environ, RESTIC_PASSWORD_FILE="/etc/restic/password")
    proc = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True, env=env, timeout=7200)
    out = (proc.stdout + proc.stderr)[-4000:]
    return PruneResult(success=proc.returncode == 0, exit_code=proc.returncode, output=out)
